cases.claim: The system achieved 99% accuracy on the benchmark.
cases.evidence: The team selected 99% as its target and plans to run the benchmark after implementation.

cases.claim: Every public hospital needs this scheduling tool.
cases.evidence: Five staff members at one hospital said they would consider trying a prototype.

cases.claim: Using the reminder app caused attendance to improve.
cases.evidence: In a voluntary survey, 14 participants said reminders were useful. No attendance measurements or comparison group were collected.

cases.claim: The pipeline runs entirely on a CPU.
cases.evidence: The tested pipeline requires a CUDA-capable GPU; CPU execution is unsupported.
The dataset license explicitly prohibits commercial use without separate written permission.
The final study report records 17 enrolled participants, not 50.
